text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
I-it's even scarier up close.
Urgh... This is too much...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
近くで見るとすごい迫力……
うう……
やっぱり怖いよぅ……

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Kurumi!
You've got me and Chika!
Not to mention {0}! It'll be okay!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だよクルミ！
私やお姉ちゃんたち……
それに、
お兄ちゃんだっているんだから！

text_block_list.name: Chika
text_block_list.text:
We won't give in!
This is a fight for our memories!
A fight to regain our peaceful days!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちは負けません！
大切な想い出を……
私たちの日常を取り戻すために！
